scheme_name: Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra Yojana: Dress for Pre-school Children
description: The 'Dress for Pre-school Children' scheme is a component of the Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra Yojana implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar. Under this state-sponsored scheme, financial assistance of ₹400 per child per year is provided to children aged 3 to 6 years enrolled in Anganwadi Centres for purchasing uniforms. The scheme aims to promote a distinct identity, uniformity, and social harmony among children receiving pre-school education.
objectives: Provide financial assistance for uniforms to children enrolled in Anganwadi Centres.
Promote uniformity and social harmony among pre-school children.
Create a distinct identity for children attending Anganwadi Centres.
Support early childhood education in Bihar.

benefits.title: Uniform Assistance
benefits.description: Financial assistance of ₹400 per child per year is provided for purchasing uniforms.

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The beneficiary should be a resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Child
eligibility.description: The beneficiary should be a child.

eligibility.title: Age
eligibility.description: The beneficiary should be between 3 and 6 years of age.

eligibility.title: Anganwadi Enrollment
eligibility.description: The beneficiary should be enrolled at an Anganwadi Centre.

eligibility.title: Pre-school Education
eligibility.description: The beneficiary should be receiving pre-school education at the Anganwadi Centre.

application_steps.title: Register Child
application_steps.description: Register the child's name at the Anganwadi Centre.

application_steps.title: Verification
application_steps.description: The Anganwadi Centre verifies the eligibility of the child.

application_steps.title: Benefit Distribution
application_steps.description: Eligible beneficiaries receive ₹400 per year for uniforms.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card of Parent(s)
documents_required.remarks: Identity proof of the parent or guardian.

documents_required.name: Birth Certificate of Child
documents_required.remarks: Proof of age of the child.

documents_required.name: Additional Supporting Documents
documents_required.remarks: Any other documents required by the concerned authority.

important_notes: The scheme is a component of the Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra Yojana.
The scheme is fully sponsored by the Government of Bihar.
Financial assistance of ₹400 is provided once every year per eligible child.
Only children enrolled in Anganwadi Centres and receiving pre-school education are eligible.
Complaints may be submitted to ICDS authorities, Child Development Project Officers, District Programme Officers, or Public Grievance Redressal Officers.

faqs.question: Who can benefit from this scheme?
faqs.answer: Children aged 3 to 6 years enrolled in Anganwadi Centres and receiving pre-school education.

faqs.question: How much financial assistance is provided?
faqs.answer: Eligible children receive ₹400 per year for purchasing uniforms.

faqs.question: How can I apply?
faqs.answer: Parents or guardians should register the child's name at the nearest Anganwadi Centre.

faqs.question: Is this a state-sponsored scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes. The scheme is fully sponsored by the Government of Bihar.

faqs.question: Which documents are required?
faqs.answer: Aadhaar card of the parent(s), birth certificate of the child, address proof, and any additional documents if required.
